guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 把上部柱力經一到三層樓高的桁架轉到下部柱或巨柱時的構件、接頭、安裝、預拱、卸撐與檢驗。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Members, joints, erection, camber, de-propping and inspection when one- to three-storey trusses carry upper column loads onto columns or mega-columns below. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: 碎片大廈以費氏格框把周邊柱距由 6 m 加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m
樂天世界塔帶狀桁架約位於 72–76 層與 104–107 層，把燈籠與飯店柱轉換到巨柱
樂天世界塔第 5 至 7 層由最低一道帶狀桁架吊掛
樂天世界塔帶狀桁架預組後現場焊接到 3.3 m 巨柱外側的預埋鋼板
赫斯特大樓 8 根長約 27 m（90 ft）的超級斜撐由第 3 層延伸到第 10 層
威利斯大樓底座改造使用 72 根轉換柱與約 80 根轉換梁，含 4 根 W40×503 型鋼梁
威利斯大樓改造中 6 根深約 1.52 m（60 in）、長約 32 m 的板梁跨越活動空間
EN 1991-1-7 關鍵構件須承受 34 kN/m² 的意外面壓
EN 1993-1-2 中利用率 0.6 的鋼構件臨界溫度約 554 °C
factsEn: The Shard's Vierendeel grids step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m
Lotte World Tower belt trusses at about floors 72–76 and 104–107 transfer the lantern and hotel columns onto mega-columns
Levels 5 to 7 of Lotte World Tower hang from the lowest belt truss
Lotte World Tower belt trusses were pre-assembled and field-welded to embedded plates on the 3.3 m mega-columns
Hearst Tower has 8 super-diagonals about 27 m (90 ft) long running from the third to the tenth floor
The Willis Tower repositioning used 72 transfer columns and about 80 transfer girders, including 4 W40×503 beams
In the Willis Tower renovation 6 plate girders about 1.52 m (60 in) deep and about 32 m long span an event space
EN 1991-1-7 key elements must resist an accidental pressure of 34 kN/m²
Under EN 1993-1-2 a steel member at 0.6 utilisation has a critical temperature of about 554 °C
timeline: 2005　赫斯特大樓結構封頂，超級斜撐把斜交網格塔身轉到歷史立面內
2006　赫斯特大樓完工，新塔身坐落在保留的歷史建築基座之上
2012　碎片大廈封頂，費氏轉換與 A 形構架調和不同用途柱網
2015　樂天世界塔封頂，帶狀桁架承托燈籠與飯店柱並吊掛低層樓板
2017–2020　威利斯大樓底座改造以轉換柱與轉換梁對齊新舊柱網
timelineEn: 2005 — Hearst Tower tops out, its super-diagonals carrying the diagrid shaft inside the historic façade
2006 — Hearst Tower is completed, its new shaft standing above the retained historic base building
2012 — The Shard tops out, with Vierendeel and A-frame transfers reconciling column grids
2015 — Lotte World Tower tops out, its belt trusses carrying the lantern and hotel columns and hanging lower floors
2017–2020 — The Willis Tower base repositioning aligns new and existing grids with transfer columns and girders
codes: AISC 303：鋼構建築與橋梁標準作業規範
codesEn: AISC 360: Specification for Structural Steel Buildings
AWS D1.1: Structural Welding Code – Steel
AISC 303: Code of Standard Practice for Steel Buildings and Bridges
EN 1991-1-7: Actions on structures – Accidental actions
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：跨層轉換桁架施工
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Multi-storey transfer-truss construction
guides.concept: 當上部樓層的柱位與下部不同，例如住宅柱網落在開闊的辦公或大廳之上，或周邊柱要集中到少數巨柱，就需要跨越一到數層樓高的轉換桁架。轉換桁架承受多層樓的集中荷重，構件厚重、接頭複雜，而且在施工中必須先完成並具足夠勁度，上方樓層才能開始施作。本課以碎片大廈的費氏轉換、樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架與吊掛樓層、赫斯特大樓的超級斜撐和威利斯大樓底座改造的轉換梁為例，談荷重路徑、吊掛、厚板焊接、接頭、整體提升、預拱與卸撐、超音波檢驗、卸載監測、防火與交接。
guides.conceptEn: When upper columns do not line up with those below, for example a residential grid over open offices or a lobby, or perimeter columns gathered onto a few mega-columns, transfer trusses one to several storeys deep are needed. They carry concentrated loads from many floors, so members are heavy and joints complex, and during construction they must be complete and stiff before the floors above can proceed. Using the Vierendeel transfers of The Shard, the belt trusses and hung floors of Lotte World Tower, the super-diagonals of the Hearst Tower and the transfer girders of the Willis Tower base repositioning, the course covers load paths, hanging, thick-plate welding, joints, lifting, camber and de-propping, ultrasonic testing, unloading monitoring, fire protection and handover.
procedure: 轉換桁架把上方不連續柱的軸力轉成桁架的彎矩與剪力，再集中送到兩端的支承柱。彎矩以上下弦桿的拉壓力偶抵抗，剪力由斜桿或豎桿承擔，因此桁架深度直接決定弦桿力：深度越大，弦桿越小。碎片大廈以鋼構費氏桁架把上部柱重新對位到辦公層，並以費氏格框把周邊柱距由 6 m 逐步加密到 3 m 再到 1.5 m；樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架則把頂部燈籠與飯店柱轉換到八根巨柱上。
有些轉換桁架不是承托上方的柱，而是吊住下方的樓層。設計者公開說明樂天世界塔的 5 至 7 層是從最低的帶狀桁架吊掛下來的。吊掛樓層的荷重先以拉力往上傳到桁架，再由桁架送到巨柱，這與一般「由下往上支承」的施工直覺相反：在桁架完成並具勁度之前，吊掛樓層不能自行站立，需要臨時支撐；吊桿受拉伸長，樓層在加載後會下沉，必須預先抬高。
轉換桁架弦桿與節點常用 50 至 100 mm 以上的厚板與巨型型鋼，焊縫多為全滲透並在節點處三向交會。厚板冷卻快、拘束大，熱影響區容易硬化並產生氫致冷裂；板厚方向受拉的接頭還有層狀撕裂的風險，需要使用 Z 向性能鋼材並調整接頭幾何。碳當量 CE 綜合了合金元素對硬化傾向的影響，是決定預熱溫度與焊接程序的起點。
轉換桁架與支承柱的接頭決定力量能否順利進入柱中。樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架由預組段件在現場焊接到巨柱外側的預埋鋼板，使巨柱混凝土能連續施作；鋼構節點則常用滑動臨界高強螺栓，以摩擦傳力而不讓接頭在反覆荷重下滑移。若接頭需容許施工期的差異變形，可先以長槽孔或暫不鎖緊的螺栓連接，待指定階段再鎖定。接頭設計必須同時考慮施工期與完工後的受力方向，因為吊掛或轉換狀態可能讓同一構件由受壓轉為受拉。
轉換桁架可以在原位以臨時支架逐件安裝，也可以在地面或較低樓層組裝後以鋼絞線千斤頂整體提升。原位安裝需要能承受桁架與上方施工荷重的臨時支架，並在高空完成大量厚板焊接；整體提升則把焊接移到地面，品質較易控制，但提升時各吊點的荷重分配、同步性與風速都是控制因素，接近就位時還要處理與支承柱的對接誤差。威利斯大樓底座改造中，最東側的一根板梁就以兩段吊裝後再續接。
轉換桁架在承受上方樓層後會撓曲，若不預拱，上方所有樓層的柱都會隨之下沉。預拱值由桁架在預期荷重下的撓度決定，包括弦桿伸縮造成的彎曲撓度與斜桿伸縮造成的剪力撓度。施工中桁架常先坐在臨時支撐上，待上方若干層完成或桁架接頭全部驗收後才分級卸撐，讓荷重逐步從臨時支撐轉到桁架；卸撐順序（由中央向兩端或反之）會影響桁架與支撐的瞬時受力。
轉換桁架的厚板全滲透焊必須做體積檢測，最常用的是超音波檢測：探頭把超音波斜射入鋼板，遇到裂縫、未熔合或夾渣時反射回探頭，依聲程與入射角換算瑕疵的深度與距離，再依反射幅度與長度判定是否合格。相位陣列超音波（PAUT）可同時掃描多個角度並保存影像，便於複核。檢驗時機要配合延遲裂縫的發生時間，並在構件被上方結構覆蓋前完成。
轉換桁架從臨時支撐轉為自行承載的過程，是驗證設計假設最好的時機。在弦桿、斜桿與支承柱上安裝應變計，配合千斤頂讀數與撓度量測，可以直接得到構件軸力，與施工階段分析逐步比較。若實測力與預測相符，表示荷重路徑與勁度假設正確；若某根斜桿明顯偏低而相鄰構件偏高，可能是接頭滑移、臨時支撐未完全釋放或桁架幾何偏差。這些資料也成為日後營運監測的基準。
轉換桁架承托多層樓，一旦失效後果遠大於一般梁柱，因此通常被列為關鍵構件，要求較高的耐火時效與更可靠的防火被覆。鋼材在高溫下強度與勁度下降，構件失效時的溫度（臨界溫度）取決於火災時的荷重利用率：利用率越低，臨界溫度越高。這與只為使用性設置、經評估可不做被覆的帽桁架不同，轉換構件的被覆厚度、附著力與完整性都必須嚴格驗收，日後改裝也不得破壞。
轉換桁架失效會讓上方所有被轉換的柱失去支承，因此常依 EN 1991-1-7 或類似規定檢核為關鍵構件：構件必須能承受額外的意外作用（例如 34 kN/m² 的面壓）而不失效。交接後最大的風險往往來自不了解其重要性的改裝：在弦桿開孔穿管、切除斜桿以增加通道、在節點旁焊接附件。交接文件必須讓營運單位知道哪些構件屬轉換與關鍵構件、它們承托哪些樓層、鎖入了哪些施工期應力，以及改裝的審查流程。
procedureEn: A transfer truss turns the axial force of discontinued upper columns into truss bending and shear and delivers it to the supporting columns at its ends. Bending is resisted by a tension–compression couple in the chords and shear by diagonals or verticals, so truss depth directly sets the chord force: the deeper the truss, the smaller the chords. The Shard used steel Vierendeel trusses to realign upper columns onto the office floors and Vierendeel grids to step perimeter column spacing from 6 m to 3 m to 1.5 m; at Lotte World Tower belt trusses transfer the lantern and hotel columns onto the eight mega-columns.

Some transfer trusses do not carry columns above but hang floors below. The designers state that levels 5 to 7 of Lotte World Tower hang from the lowest belt truss. Loads from hung floors travel up in tension to the truss and then to the mega-columns, the opposite of the usual bottom-up construction logic: until the truss is complete and stiff, the hung floors cannot stand by themselves and need temporary shoring, and because the hangers stretch in tension, the floors drop as load arrives and must be set high in advance.

Chords and joints of transfer trusses often use plates 50 to 100 mm thick or more and jumbo sections, with complete-penetration welds meeting in three directions at the nodes. Thick plates cool fast under high restraint, so heat-affected zones harden and hydrogen-induced cold cracks can form; joints loaded through the plate thickness also risk lamellar tearing, calling for through-thickness (Z-grade) steel and adjusted joint geometry. The carbon equivalent CE sums the hardening tendency of alloying elements and is the starting point for preheat and welding procedures.

The joints between a transfer truss and its supporting columns decide whether force can enter the columns smoothly. At Lotte World Tower belt trusses were pre-assembled and field-welded to embedded steel plates on the outside of the mega-columns so the column concrete could be cast continuously; steel nodes commonly use slip-critical high-strength bolts that transfer force by friction without slipping under reversing load. Where joints must accommodate construction-stage differential movement, they can be connected first with long slots or untightened bolts and locked at a specified stage. Joint design must cover force directions both during construction and after completion, because hanging or transfer states can turn a compression member into a tension member.

A transfer truss can be erected piece by piece in place on temporary towers, or assembled at ground or a lower floor and lifted whole with strand jacks. In-place erection needs temporary towers that carry the truss and construction loads above and requires extensive thick-plate welding at height; lifting moves the welding to the ground where quality is easier to control, but load sharing between lifting points, synchronisation and wind govern the lift, and the fit-up to supporting columns must be resolved near final position. On the Willis Tower base repositioning, the easternmost plate girder was lifted in two pieces and spliced.

A transfer truss deflects as the floors above load it, and without camber every column above drops with it. Camber is set from the truss deflection under expected load, including flexural deflection from chord strain and shear deflection from diagonal strain. During construction the truss often sits first on temporary supports and is de-propped in stages only after several floors above are complete or all its joints are accepted, so load moves gradually from the props to the truss; the release order, from the centre outward or the reverse, affects the transient forces in truss and props.

Complete-penetration welds in transfer-truss plates need volumetric inspection, most commonly ultrasonic testing: a probe sends an angled ultrasonic beam into the plate, and cracks, lack of fusion or slag reflect it back; the sound path and beam angle give the flaw's depth and distance, and its echo amplitude and length decide acceptance. Phased-array ultrasonics (PAUT) scan several angles at once and keep images for review. Inspection timing must allow for delayed cracking and be completed before the member is covered by the structure above.

Transferring a truss from temporary supports to self-supporting is the best moment to verify design assumptions. Strain gauges on chords, diagonals and supporting columns, together with jack readings and deflection surveys, give member forces directly for step-by-step comparison with the construction-stage analysis. Agreement confirms the load path and stiffness assumptions; a diagonal clearly lower than predicted with neighbours higher may indicate joint slip, a prop not fully released or geometric deviation. The data also become the baseline for later in-service monitoring.

A transfer truss supports many floors, so its failure has far greater consequences than that of an ordinary beam or column; it is usually designated a key element with a higher fire-resistance period and more reliable fire protection. Steel loses strength and stiffness at high temperature, and the temperature at which a member fails, its critical temperature, depends on the load utilisation in fire: the lower the utilisation, the higher the critical temperature. Unlike hat trusses provided only for serviceability and judged not to need protection, transfer members require strict acceptance of protection thickness, adhesion and integrity, which later alterations must not damage.

Failure of a transfer truss leaves every transferred column above unsupported, so it is often checked as a key element under EN 1991-1-7 or similar rules: the member must withstand an additional accidental action, for example a pressure of 34 kN/m², without failure. After handover the greatest risk often comes from alterations by people unaware of its importance: holes in chords for services, removed diagonals for passageways, attachments welded next to nodes. Handover documents must tell the operator which members are transfers and key elements, which floors they carry, what construction-stage stresses are locked in, and how alterations are reviewed.
evidence: 轉換層的深度、斜桿位置與穿越管線的開口應在設計初期與建築、機電共同凍結，任何後續變更都需結構工程師重新核算並更新預拱值。
吊掛樓層的臨時支撐拆除列為停留點：桁架與吊桿接頭檢驗合格、預拱量確認、分級卸撐程序與停止條件（例如任一千斤頂偏差超過 10%）經結構工程師核准後才可執行。
厚板節點須有經認可的焊接程序規範、預熱與層間溫度紀錄、焊後保溫或延遲檢驗時間（例如 48 小時後才做超音波檢測），並由焊接檢驗師簽認後才可往上安裝。
接頭圖說應標明摩擦面處理等級、螺栓等級與預拉方法，並區分「施工期可滑動」與「最終鎖定」的螺栓；最終鎖定作業與檢驗紀錄須由結構工程師確認。
提升作業屬高風險重型吊裝，須有經核准的提升計畫（含吊點設計、同步控制、試吊、風速限制、緊急停止與人員禁入區），由提升專業廠商與結構工程師共同簽認，並由合格的吊裝主管指揮。
evidenceEn: Freeze the depth, diagonal layout and service openings of transfer levels early with architecture and building services, and require any later change to be recalculated by the structural engineer with updated camber.

Make removal of shores under hung floors a hold point released by the structural engineer only after truss and hanger joints pass inspection, the pre-set is confirmed and a staged release procedure with stop criteria, for example any jack deviating by more than 10%, is approved.

Thick-plate nodes need a qualified welding procedure specification, preheat and interpass records, post-weld insulation or a delayed inspection time, for example ultrasonic testing only after 48 hours, and sign-off by the welding inspector before erection continues above.

Joint drawings should state faying-surface class, bolt grade and pretensioning method and distinguish bolts that may slip during construction from those finally locked; final locking and its inspection records must be confirmed by the structural engineer.

Lifting is a high-risk heavy operation requiring an approved lift plan covering lifting-point design, synchronisation, test lift, wind limits, emergency stop and exclusion zones, signed jointly by the specialist lifting contractor and the structural engineer and directed by a qualified lifting supervisor.
pitfalls: 若低估上部柱力（例如漏算改用途後的荷重）或把桁架深度在建築協調中壓縮，弦桿與節點應力會大幅上升；轉換桁架撓度過大則讓上方所有樓層跟著下沉，隔間與帷幕牆開裂。
預熱不足或焊材受潮會在焊後數小時到數天才出現延遲裂縫，若在檢驗前就繼續安裝上方構件，裂縫被覆蓋而難以發現；板厚方向受拉的接頭若使用一般鋼板，可能在焊接收縮時就產生層狀撕裂。
吊點同步失控時某一吊點超載，可能導致千斤頂或錨具破壞，桁架扭轉；原位安裝若臨時支架沉陷，桁架在焊接前就變形，焊後鎖入應力與幾何誤差。
若檢驗在焊後太早進行或被略過，延遲裂縫可能在上方樓層加載後擴展，轉換桁架節點在服務荷重下開裂；以錯誤的入射角或未校正的儀器檢測，會把瑕疵定位錯誤而修錯位置。
後續機電管線或吊架安裝時刮除或鑽穿轉換桁架的被覆而未修補，火災時該處鋼材提早升溫，轉換構件失效可能導致上方多層樓板塌落。
pitfallsEn: Underestimating upper column loads, for example by missing loads from a change of use, or squeezing the truss depth in architectural coordination sharply raises chord and joint stresses; excessive transfer-truss deflection drags every floor above down with it and cracks partitions and façades.

Insufficient preheat or damp consumables cause delayed cracks hours or days after welding, and if members above are erected before inspection the cracks are hidden; ordinary plate in joints loaded through the thickness can tear lamellarly from weld shrinkage alone.

Loss of synchronisation can overload one point and break a jack or anchorage while twisting the truss; in in-place erection a settling temporary tower deforms the truss before welding, locking in stress and geometric error after welding.

Inspecting too soon after welding, or skipping it, lets delayed cracks grow once the floors above load the node, cracking the transfer joint in service; testing with the wrong beam angle or an uncalibrated instrument mislocates flaws so the wrong spot is repaired.

If later services or hangers scrape off or drill through the protection on a transfer truss without repair, the steel there heats early in a fire, and failure of the transfer can bring down several floors above.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「轉換桁架的荷重路徑」與「全滲透焊的超音波檢驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path through a transfer truss" and "Ultrasonic inspection of complete-penetration welds" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Mega-column and outrigger structural systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把上部柱力經一到三層樓高的桁架轉到下部柱或巨柱時的構件、接頭、安裝、預拱、卸撐與檢驗；巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統則以外伸臂把核心筒轉角轉成巨柱軸力的勁度原理、最佳位置、核心牆接合、差異縮短延遲鎖定與阻尼外伸臂為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on members, joints, erection, camber, de-propping and inspection when one- to three-storey trusses carry upper column loads onto columns or mega-columns below; Mega-column and outrigger structural systems centres on how outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force: stiffness, optimum level, core-wall connections, delayed lock-off and damped outriggers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉換桁架弦桿與斜桿力」與「核心轉角與柱軸向勁度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測外伸臂受力並回推系統勁度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Transfer-truss chord and diagonal forces” and “Core rotation and column axial stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Mega-column and outrigger structural systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Measuring outrigger forces to back-calculate system stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 跨層轉換桁架施工
history.text: 以深梁或桁架轉換柱位是高層建築的老問題，隨著混合用途塔樓興起而更常見：上部住宅或飯店的密柱要落在下部開闊的辦公、大廳或車站之上。2006 年完工的紐約赫斯特大樓以八根長約 27 m 的超級斜撐由第 3 層延伸到第 10 層，把斜交網格塔身的荷重送到保留的歷史立面內；2012 年封頂的碎片大廈以費氏桁架與 A 形構架轉換不同用途的柱網；2015 年封頂的樂天世界塔以帶狀桁架把燈籠與飯店柱轉到巨柱，並吊掛低層樓板；威利斯大樓在 2017 至 2020 年改造中以轉換柱與轉換梁把新裙樓的柱網對齊既有塔樓。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Transferring columns with deep beams or trusses is an old tall-building problem that has become more frequent with mixed-use towers, where dense residential or hotel columns must land over open offices, lobbies or stations below. The Hearst Tower in New York, completed in 2006, used eight super-diagonals about 27 m long running from the third to the tenth floor to carry its diagrid shaft down inside the retained historic façade; The Shard, topped out in 2012, used Vierendeel trusses and A-frames to transfer between column grids for different uses; Lotte World Tower, topped out in 2015, used belt trusses to carry the lantern and hotel columns onto mega-columns and to hang lower floors; and the 2017 to 2020 Willis Tower renovation used transfer columns and girders to align a new podium's grid with the existing tower. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
